description:
Pokémon Battle Revolution is the series' first game on the Wii. Battle through 10 different Colosseums
on your way to the rank of Pokétopia Master, all in the mainline games' famous turn-based battles!

## Changelog
- It's the initial release!
## Known Issues
The D-Pad controls are, for the most part, completely unusable when selecting a Colosseum to enter. Fixing this would take a complete rewrite of how this functions, so don't expect it for a bit.
For now, you can use the Wii Remote pointer instead.
v0.1.0.title: Pokémon Battle Revolution 0.1.0

v0.1.1.description:
- [Info Page](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/en_Pok%C3%A9mon%20Battle%20Revolution.md)
- [Setup Guide](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/setup_en.md)
## Changelog
- Fixed the D-Pad controls in the Colosseum Battle menu.
- Fixed an issue where the client wouldn't connect unless the Player already had at least 1 save file.
- Fixed an issue where the client would sometimes fail to get the multiworld seed.
- Fixed an issue where multiworlds generated with the same seed could have different starting Colosseums.
- disc-riider-py is no longer required to load the APWorld and generate multiworlds (it is still required to patch the game though).
- Raised the minimum AP version to 0.6.8
v0.1.1.title: Pokémon Battle Revolution 0.1.1
